pr_title: audit: Make `--display-failures-only` the default for Casks
pr_body:
- [x] Have you followed the guidelines in our [Contributing](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md) document?
- [x] Have you checked to ensure there aren't other open [Pull Requests](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pulls) for the same change?
- [x] Have you added an explanation of what your changes do and why you'd like us to include them?
- [x] Have you written new tests for your changes? [Here's an example](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/HEAD/Library/Homebrew/test/PATH_spec.rb).
- [x] Have you successfully run `brew style` with your changes locally?
- [x] Have you successfully run `brew typecheck` with your changes locally?
- [x] Have you successfully run `brew tests` with your changes locally?

-----

- Fixes #15074.
- Deprecate `brew audit --display-failures-only` for Casks. The default behaviour for formulae is to only display failures, so let's make Casks behave the same way since all the warnings are noisy.
- Only show warnings (less important errors, I guess, now) for Casks if `--strict` (or `--new-cask` which implies `--strict`) is used in `brew audit`.
pr_comments: Looks like `cask audit` is failing but everything else looks 🎉 https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/actions/runs/4610240508/jobs/8150188692?pr=15105#step:7:18
Effectively, an archived repo implies that the cask is discontinued. So adding a `discontinued` should fix the audit error.
Thanks Markus. Sorry, on my phone, didn't actually test that it worked. 😅
Closing and re-opening to re-trigger the "expected" CI checks.

issue_context.title: Remove `brew audit --display-failures-only`
issue_context.body:
### Verification

- [X] This issue's title and/or description do not reference a single formula e.g. `brew install wget`. If they do, open an issue at https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/issues/new/choose instead.

### Provide a detailed description of the proposed feature

`brew audit --display-failures-only` should be `odeprecated`, made the default behaviour and omitting it replaced with `--strict` (or, if appropriate, `--git`, `--online`, `--new-cask`, etc.)



### What is the motivation for the feature?

It's confusing to have a behaviour like this that applies only for casks when there's an equivalent already there for formulae. Similarly, the default output without `--display-failures-only` is very hard to follow as it's hard to find the actual error over all the warnings.

### How will the feature be relevant to at least 90% of Homebrew users?

Improved contributor and maintainer productivity.

### What alternatives to the feature have been considered?

Doing nothing.
comments:
> brew audit --display-failures-only should be odeprecated, made the default behaviour and omitting it replaced with --strict (or, if appropriate, --git, --online, --new-cask, etc.)

I don't understand the last part of this sentence.

1. should be `odeprecated` 👍🏻
2. made the default behaviour 👍🏻
3. omitting it replaced with `--strict` or others ❓

Omitting what? If only showing failures is the default that we want then the user would type a plain `brew audit <cask>` command. Do we need a reverse switch for `--display-everything` or `--all` or something which shows `--strict` and friends?
Yes, a lot more sense, thanks!
